pages.text: With a Staff, an equipped Mage Backpack, and mana in its Canister, I can finally express a spell. Left-click casts the currently selected spell. Holding right-click opens the radial selection; releasing it chooses the highlighted prepared slot.

$(bold)Mage Light$() was already present in my memory, though useless without a focus. It costs one full bucket of mana and launches a lasting luminous orb.$(br2)Only calibrated spells appear in the radial menu. Failed casts preserve mana when their target or conditions are invalid.
pages.title: Mage Light and Calibration

pages.text: I have not yet settled the Staff's exact construction diagram, though its requirements are clear: it must be a deliberate magical focus rather than an ordinary tool.$(br2)Insight now feels as though it could be arranged into a structure. A Tome Table may allow that organization.
pages.title: Toward the Tome
